Charging station incentives (labelled table reading):
Small charging stations: On chargers, capital subsidy of 30% of the value of charging equipment/machinery for the first 500 charging stations, maximum INR 1,50,000.
Medium charging stations: On chargers, capital subsidy of 30% of the value of charging equipment/machinery for the first 300 stations, maximum INR 3,00,000.
Large charging stations: On chargers, capital subsidy of 30% of the value of charging equipment/machinery for the first 200 stations, maximum INR 10,00,000.
Battery swapping stations: One-time capital subsidy on eligible fixed capital investment for service providers at 30%, for the first 300 swap stations in the State, maximum INR 5,00,000.

observations.question: What NOC deadline, safety exceptions and written-rejection requirement does section 14 state for resident charging from an RWA common load connection?

result.answer:
Madhya Pradesh — source cutoff: 2026-09-23.

Prototype source review is pending; current availability and individual eligibility are not verified.

- RWAs must issue a No‑Objection Certificate within seven working days of receiving a resident’s request. [S6](https://www.mpurban.gov.in/Uploaded%20Document/guidelines/Notified_EV_Guideline_MP2025.pdf#page=20)
- The seven‑day deadline does not apply if there are valid safety concerns or any breach of contemporary standards, guidelines, instructions, directives, orders or codes related to installation, operation or maintenance of the charging infrastructure. [S6](https://www.mpurban.gov.in/Uploaded%20Document/guidelines/Notified_EV_Guideline_MP2025.pdf#page=20)
- If the RWA denies the NOC, it must provide written reasons for the rejection within the same seven‑day period. [S6](https://www.mpurban.gov.in/Uploaded%20Document/guidelines/Notified_EV_Guideline_MP2025.pdf#page=20)
- A NOC is required only when a resident seeks to install a higher‑capacity charging system that draws power from the RWA’s common load; a 15 A socket from the resident’s own meter is exempt. [S5](https://www.mpurban.gov.in/Uploaded%20Document/guidelines/Notified_EV_Guideline_MP2025.pdf#page=19)
